results.raw_content:
E/ECE/324/Rev.2/Add.147

Regulation No. 148

Uniform provisions concerning the approval of light-signalling devices (LSD) for power-driven vehicles and their trailers

1. Scope
1.1. This Regulation applies to light-signalling devices intended to be fitted to vehicles of categories M, N and O with regard to: position (side) lamps, stop lamps, direction indicator lamps, rear registration plate illuminating devices, front and rear fog lamps, reversing lamps, parking lamps, daytime running lamps, side marker lamps and retro-reflectors, as listed in paragraph 3. below.
1.2. This Regulation does not apply to devices intended for signalling by hand.

2. Definitions
For the purposes of this Regulation, general definitions are set out in the UN Regulation on general safety provisions, and the following definitions apply:
2.1. "Approval of a device" means the approval of a type of light-signalling device with regard to the requirements laid down in this Regulation...
